traceability.notes:
The 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING story is fully implemented and verified. All specified rules expose clear, specific, and consistent error messages through meta.messages, using the shared conventions described in the story (placeholders like {{functionName}}, {{missing}}, {{details}}, {{path}}, {{reqId}}, {{storyPath}}). The rules integrate with ESLint’s reporting mechanisms via context.report, always providing a node for accurate locations and populating data fields to give context (function name, file path, requirement ID, detailed explanation).
Concrete Jest/RuleTester suites exercise each rule’s error behavior and explicitly reference this story and its REQ-ERROR-* requirements. They assert the correct messageIds, placeholder data, and—where applicable—ESLint suggestions and auto-fix behavior. File and requirement reference rules distinguish between missing resources, invalid formats, and filesystem errors, and handle incomplete error context gracefully. Together, the implementation and tests meet all acceptance criteria: specific and actionable messages, ESLint-style quality, integration with existing rules, clear UX (problem, location, suggested fix), robust error handling, and documented message formats.
